answers.rationale: This requirement is about compliance and the role of an independent design consultant. It does not specify a product or service from the catalog, so no units are listed.
The critical IT load of 120 MW distributed in six units of 20 MW each aligns with the FPM-DCPDU product, which is designed for high-power DC distribution in AI racks.
The requirement for 15 kV class medium-voltage equipment matches the CROWN-ARMV product, which is arc-resistant metal-clad MV switchgear suitable for such applications.
The distribution to the rack at 800 VDC nominal aligns with the FPM-800V product, which is designed for 800 VDC rack power distribution.
The baseline rack cabinets and their power requirements align with the CLOUD-RACK product, which provides data-center racks and enclosures capable of supporting high TDP and power densities.
This requirement is about availability targets and design intent, which are not directly tied to a specific product from the catalog.
The block redundancy with a catcher aligns with the FPM-DCPDU product, which supports high-power distribution and redundancy configurations.
The liquid cooling design point of 45 °C facility water matches the JETCOOL-CDU product, which is designed for high-density liquid cooling.
This requirement specifies environmental conditions for the design but does not directly specify a product from the catalog.
The outdoor equipment requirements, including environmental and seismic ratings, align with the CROWN-EHOUSE product, which is designed for robust outdoor applications.
This compliance requirement about utility interconnection agreements and permits does not specify a product or service from the catalog.
